scope: Owner-requested exploratory offline mechanism check; no retraining, no fights, no source-recursion qualification.
dtype: float32 (selected training checkpoint; exact equality to float32 cast of export)

test.selection: Same four selected_starts windows of 90 physical ticks as outcome.test; full prefix replay separately for every dynamic intervention, never reuse intact stored snapshots. Reset-disabled reuses intact outputs exactly; drift-only removal reuses intact state/heads and zeros output drift. Both are structural identities verified by tests.
test.provenance: Sealed Stage A whole-fight split matched exactly to Stage B round0; raw recording hashes checked.

definitions.target_accuracy: argmax pointer including None; unit-row weighted
definitions.calibrated_fire_accuracy: unchanged validation thresholds from each arm export; no recalibration
definitions.calibrated_fire_with_safety_accuracy: same threshold plus calibration.collect_scores allowed mask (active/guard/busy), not complete native arbitration
definitions.move_smooth_l1: mean beta=1 SmoothL1 across x/y in 100 px units, including drift
definitions.aim_smooth_l1: mean beta=1 SmoothL1 across x/y in 100 px units, oracle aim mask only; null when no labels
definitions.phase: At scored ticks after physical update; R=abs(mean(exp(i theta))) within role per tick. R means weight ticks equally; histogram/forcing weight units. Pair fraction weights unordered within-role pairs. No inferred discrete cluster count.
definitions.phase_rate_units: omega, forcing and coupling in radians/second; phase bins radians modulo 2pi
definitions.coupling_rate: Instantaneous coupling RHS evaluated at post-step theta, not realized RK4 whole-step average. Hypothetical under frozen_phase: actual phase rate is zero.
definitions.forcing: Learned tanh output retained in the head in all cuts. effective_phase_forcing is its value used in the phase RHS; zero only for no_geometry_to_mode.

interventions.intact: Unchanged trained forward law and readouts.
interventions.k_zero: K=0; retain omega, learned forcing, phase readouts and drift.
interventions.frozen_phase: Hold each persistent ID phase at its deterministic initial value; retain forcing and all phase readouts.
interventions.reset_disabled: Exact no-op: pinned model has no attack-triggered reset; fight initialization and ID remapping remain required.
interventions.topology_only: Freeze directed edges, distances, weights and displacement vectors at first recorded tick; remove dead endpoints without recruiting neighbors. Public tokens, assignments and speeds remain live.
interventions.no_mode_to_geometry: Zero output drift only. Recorded positions remain exogenous; phase and heads unchanged.
interventions.no_geometry_to_mode: Zero input-dependent forcing only in the phase RHS and zero geometry-weighted coupling; phase advances only by learned omega. Retain the learned forcing scalar in the head, geometry in attention/heads, and phase-dependent drift/readouts.
